Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the client to log in to the market data gateway.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: CompID assigned to the client.

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the CompID.

Message.Name: Replay Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the client on the replay channel to request retransmission of a range of messages.

Field.Name: Market Data Group
Field.Description: Identity of the market data group the replay request relates to.

Field.Name: First Message
Field.Description: Sequence number of the first message in the range to be retransmitted.

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: Number of messages to be resent.

Message.Name: Snapshot Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the client on the recovery channel to request a snapshot of current state.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number the snapshot should be synchronised with.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the request relates to. Contains only spaces if it does not relate to a segment.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument the request relates to. Contains only spaces if it does not relate to an instrument and the Segment field is populated.

Field.Name: Reserved A
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Reserved B
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books the request relates to.

Field.Name: Snapshot Type
Field.Description: Type of snapshot being requested.

Field.Name: Recover From Time
Field.Description: Sending time of the last processed trade in local server time for Trades, or the last received announcement for News. Ignored for any other snapshot type.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Optional identifier used by the client to track requests sent on the recovery channel.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the client to log out of the market data gateway. Carries no fields beyond the message header.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server in response to a Login Request.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status of the login request.

Message.Name: Replay Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server in response to a Replay Request.

Field.Name: Market Data Group
Field.Description: Identity of the market data group the replay response relates to.

Field.Name: First Message
Field.Description: Sequence number of the first message to be retransmitted. Zero if Status is not A.

Field.Name: Count
Field.Description: Number of messages to be resent. Zero if Status is not A.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status of the replay request.

Message.Name: Snapshot Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server in response to a Snapshot Request.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number with which the snapshot is synchronised.

Field.Name: Order Count
Field.Description: Number of orders that will be transmitted. Zero if Status is not A, and ignored if Snapshot Type is not Order Book.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status of the snapshot request.

Field.Name: Snapshot Type
Field.Description: Type of snapshot being returned.

Field.Name: Request ID
Field.Description: Identifier echoed from the Snapshot Request.

Message.Name: Snapshot Complete Message
Message.Description: Sent by the server to mark the end of a snapshot.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number with which the snapshot is synchronised.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the snapshot relates to. Contains only spaces if it does not relate to a segment.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument the snapshot relates to. Contains only spaces if it does not relate to an instrument.

Field.Name: Reserved A
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Reserved B
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books the snapshot relates to.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Indicated only when the message is sent as a book level complete and the Snapshot Type is Order Book or Statistics.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: Sent for every second in which at least one application message is generated. All subsequent messages carry a nanosecond offset from this time.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight, in local server time rather than Utc.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Sent to signal the start and end of the trading day.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since the last Time message.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: The system event being signalled.

Message.Name: Symbol Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminates the reference data of each instrument carried on the feed. The six fields from Leg 1 Symbol onward are published only on the derivative market data groups; on the equity market data groups the message ends after Corporate Action.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since the last Time message.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Jse unique numeric instrument identifier.

Field.Name: Reserved A
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Reserved B
Field.Description: Reserved field.

Field.Name: Symbol Status
Field.Description: Status of the instrument. Contains a space when the instrument is active.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: International Securities Identifying Number.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of the instrument.

Field.Name: TIDM
Field.Description: Tradable Instrument Display Mnemonic. The revision history records that this field is reclassified as reserved at release 7.8.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the instrument is assigned to.

Field.Name: Previous Close Price
Field.Description: Previous close price of the instrument.

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date the instrument expires or matures. Contains only spaces if the instrument is not a derivative or fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of the underlying instrument. Contains only spaces if the instrument is not a derivative.

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Strike price of an option. Zero if the instrument is not an option.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Whether the instrument is a call or a put. Contains a space if the instrument is not an option.

Field.Name: Issuer
Field.Description: Issuer of the instrument. Contains all spaces if the instrument is not a fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Issue Date
Field.Description: Date the instrument was issued. Contains all spaces if the instrument is not a fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Coupon
Field.Description: Rate of interest applied to the face value, as a percentage where 0.05 represents five percent. Zero if the instrument is not a fixed income instrument.

Field.Name: Symbol Directory Flags
Field.Description: Instrument level flags.

Field.Name: Sub Book Flags
Field.Description: Order books the instrument trades on.

Field.Name: Corporate Action
Field.Description: Ex marker and annotation information associated with the instrument, if any.

Field.Name: Leg 1 Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of the leg 1 instrument. Contains only spaces if the instrument is not multi legged. Derivative market data groups only.

Field.Name: Leg 2 Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of the leg 2 instrument. Contains only spaces if the instrument is not multi legged. Derivative market data groups only.

Field.Name: Contract Multiplier
Field.Description: Multiplier of the instrument. Zero if the instrument has no contract multiplier. Derivative market data groups only.

Field.Name: Settlement Method
Field.Description: Settlement method of the underlying contract. Contains only spaces if the instrument has no settlement method. Derivative market data groups only.

Field.Name: Instrument Sub Category
Field.Description: Instrument sub category the instrument belongs to. Derivative market data groups only.

Field.Name: Exercise Style
Field.Description: Exercise style of an options instrument. Contains a space if the instrument is not an option. Derivative market data groups only.
